params.name: actionType
params.description: Filter actions by their type. Type can be any one of the enumerated values.

params.name: agentPoolId
params.description: Agent pool ID. Mandatory when RBAC is enabled. Ignored when RBAC is disabled.

params.name: createdAtAfter
params.description: Filter actions created after the specified date. Date format is <YYYY-MM-DD>.

params.name: createdAtBefore
params.description: Filter actions created before the specified date. Date format is <YYYY-MM-DD>. (UTC)

params.name: createdBy
params.description: Filter actions created by the specified user or API key. Users are identified by their email address.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Filter actions by their state. State can be either ‘true’ (enabled) or ‘false’ (disabled).

params.name: expired
params.description: Filter actions by their expiration state. Expiration state can be either ‘true’ (expired) or ‘false’ (disabled).

params.name: filename
params.description: Filter actions by the file on which they were set. Files are indicated by their full path, as provided in the action’s creation. This filter supports * as a wildcard to match multiple file names with a common pattern.

params.name: hasErrors
params.description: Filter actions which have any errors. The flag can be either ‘true’ (with errors) or ‘false’ (without errors).

params.name: page
params.description: Specifies a zero-based index of the results page to retrieve. The default is 0 (the first page).

params.name: resultsExist
params.description: Filter actions based on whether results have (true) or haven’t (false) been captured for them.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of items to include on each page of results. The default is 20.

params.name: sort
params.description: The sorting criteria in the format property (asc|desc), with ascending as the default. Multiple sort parameters can be chained to define primary, secondary, and further sorting levels (e.g., sort=field1,asc&sort=field2,desc). Sortable fields: location, line, createdAt.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter actions by status. Status can be any one of the enumerated values.
